'''Ismat Beg''', [[Fellow of the Pakistan Academy of Sciences|FPAS]], [[Institute of Mathematics and its Applications|FIMA]], ({{langx|ur|عصمت بیگ}}; born January 1951) is a Pakistani [[mathematician]] and [[researcher]]. Beg is a Distinguished National Professor at [[Lahore School of Economics]],<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |url=https://lahoreschoolofeconomics.edu.pk/getFacultyProfile/64/5 |title=Dr ismat Beg |publisher=Lahore School of Economics |access-date=2018-06-22}}</ref> [[Higher Education Commission of Pakistan|Higher Education Commission]]<ref name=:7>{{cite web|url=https://www.paspk.org/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/NewsLetter-July-2017.pdf|title=Dr. Ismat Beg, Fellow of PAS Honored by HEC|website=paspk.org|access-date=11 April 2023|page=3|date=July 2017}}</ref> and an honorary full professor at the Mathematics Division at the Ruggero Santilli Institute for Basic Research, Florida, US. 
Beg's scientific contributions cover a wide range of topics spanning fixed point theory and approximations, order structure, fuzzy sets and systems, artificial intelligence and multicriteria decision theory.<ref name=":9">{{Cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Ismat_Beg|title=Ismat BEG &#124; Professor &#124; PhD &#124; Lahore School of Economics, Lahore &#124; Mathematics and Statistics &#124; Research profile|accessdate=11 April 2023}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web | url=https://publons.com/researcher/647606/ismat-beg/publications/ | title=Ismat Beg's Publons profile}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Ismat Beg was born in the small hilly village of [[Mohri Sharif]], west of [[Kharian]] in 1951 to an immigrant [[Kashmiris|Kashmiri]] family. He got his primary schooling in a village school "sitting under the trees". In 1961 his father took him to [[Risalpur]] and he was sent to Sapper Boys High School, Risalpur Cantt. After completing his matriculation 1966, he joined Zamindar College, Bhimber Road, Gujrat (now [[Government Zamindar College, Gujrat]]) for his [[Higher Secondary School Certificate]] and undergraduate degree. He obtained his master's from Government College, Lahore <ref>{{Cite web | url=https://gcu.edu.pk/gcu-alumini/ | title=Ismat Beg | publisher=Government College, Lahore | access-date=13 January 2021 | archive-date=16 January 2021 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210116052215/https://gcu.edu.pk/gcu-alumini/ | url-status=dead }}</ref> (now [[Government College University (Lahore)|Government College University]]).<ref name=":9"/>
In 1977, Beg travelled to [[Romania]] on a scholarship and attended the [[West University of Timișoara]] for [[Romanian language]] and pre-doctoral courses and passed the PhD entrance exam for the [[University of Bucharest]]. He started his PhD in fall of 1978 under the supervision of [[academician]] and famous mathematician Romulus Cristescu.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=58586 |title=Ismat Beg |publisher=The Mathematics Genealogy Project |access-date=2018-06-22}}</ref> His area of research is ordered vector spaces and linear operators with specialization in integral representation of linear operators. He defended his thesis in December 1981 and the degree was awarded in 1982.<ref name=":15">{{cite web|url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=58588|title=Romulus Cristescu |publisher=The Mathematics Genealogy Project}}</ref><ref name="Pride">{{cite web|title=Ismat Beg {{!}} Pride of Pakistan {{!}} Commemorations {{!}} PrideOfPakistan.com|url=https://www.prideofpakistan.com/detail-who-is-who.php?name=Dr-Ismat-Beg&id=859|website=prideofpakistan.com|publisher=Pride|language=en}}</ref>

==Academic career==
Ismat Beg started teaching just after his PhD in 1982 and has taught at<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":0" /><ref name=":16">
{{cite web|url=http://www.lahoreschoolofeconomics.edu.pk/Faculty/CentreMathematicsStatisticalSciences.aspx|title=Centre For Mathematics & Statistical Sciences|publisher=Lahore School of Economics}}</ref> 
* [[Lahore School of Economics]]
* [[Lahore University of Management Sciences]]
* [[Kuwait University]]
* [[Quaid-i-Azam University]]
* [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]]
* [[Pakistan Navy Engineering College]], [[National University of Sciences and Technology (Pakistan)|National University of Sciences and Technology]]
* [[Nankai University]]
* [[University of Central Punjab]]
He has published research papers in the fields of mathematics, computer science, economics, game theory, engineering, decision theory and social sciences that have been well cited by other researchers.<ref name=RID>{{cite web |title=Ismat A Beg C-3015-2008 |url=http://www.researcherid.com/rid/C-3015-2008 |website=[[ResearcherID]] |publisher=[[Clarivate Analytics]] |accessdate=2018-07-28}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Scopus preview – Scopus – Author details (Beg, Ismat) |url=https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=57203122555 |website=[[Scopus]] |publisher=[[Elsevier]] |accessdate=2018-07-28}}</ref> He has contributed to the fields of [[fixed point theory]], [[fuzzy set theory]], order structures, preference modeling and multi-criteria multi-agent decision making.<ref name=RID/><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com.pk/citations?user=ShBx4AwAAAAJ&hl=en |title=Ismat Beg |publisher=Google Scholar Citations |access-date=2018-06-22}}</ref> Beg has supervised 12 [[M.Phil.]] theses, 7 Ph.D. dissertations, and 10 post doctoral researchers.<ref name=":2" /> He is member of the [[editorial board]]s of
* ''Proceeding [[Pakistan Academy of Sciences]]''<ref name=":11">{{cite web | url=http://www.paspk.org/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/Editorial-Board_Journal-A.pdf | publisher=Pakistan Academy of Sciences | title=A. Physical and Computational Sciences | accessdate=7 February 2020 }}</ref>
* ''Journal Function Spaces''<ref name=":12">{{cite journal|url=https://www.hindawi.com/journals/jfs/editors/|title=
Editorial Board|journal=Journal of Function Spaces |date=2022 |publisher=Hindawi|doi=10.1155/9303 |doi-access=free }}</ref>
* ''Gulf Journal of Mathematics ''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://gjom.org/index.php/gjom |title=Gulf Journal of Mathematics | publisher=...}}</ref>
* ''Punjab University Journal of Mathematics''<ref name=":13">{{Cite web|url=http://pu.edu.pk/home/journal/pujm/Editorial-Board.html|title=Punjab University Journal of Mathematics - Editorial Board|website=pu.edu.pk|accessdate=11 April 2023}}</ref>
* [[Military Technical Courier (journal)]]<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://www.vtg.mod.gov.rs/editorial-board.html#.W-ATSGdDs5s |title = Military Technical Courier &#124; Editorial board}}</ref>

== Key publications ==
* 1992. "Fixed points of asymptotically regular multivalued mappings", J. Austral. Math. Soc., (Series-A) 53(3), 313–326.
* 1995. "Random extension theorems", J. Math. Anal. Appl., 196(1), 43–52. 
* 2000. "Fuzzy closed graph fuzzy multi-functions", Fuzzy Sets & Systems, 115(3), 451 – 454.
* 2002 "Approximation of random fixed points in normed spaces", Nonlinear Anal.: Theory, Methods & Appl., 51(8), 1363–1372.
* 2006. "Iterative procedures for solution of random operator equations in Banach spaces", J. Math. Anal. Appl., 315(1), 181–201.
* 2009. "Similarity measures for fuzzy sets", Applied & Comp. Math., 8, 192–202
* 2009. "Fixed point for set valued mappings satisfying an implicit relation in partially ordered metric spaces", Nonlinear Anal.: Theory, Methods & Appl., 71(9), 3699–3704 
* 2011. "Numerical representation of product transitive complete fuzzy orderings", Math. & Computer Modelling, 153, 617–623. 
* 2013. "TOPSIS for hesitant fuzzy linguistic term sets", Int. J. Intelligent Systems, 28, 1162–1171.  
* 2016. "Incomplete interval valued fuzzy preference relations", Information Sciences, 348, 15–24. 
* 2018. "Human attitude analysis based on fuzzy soft differential equations with Bonferroni mean", Computational & Applied Math., 37(3), 2632–2647.
* 2021. "Fixed point of multivalued contractions by altering distances with application to nonconvex Hammerstein type integral inclusions", Fixed Point Theory, 22(1), 327 – 342.
* 2023. "Dissilient interpersonal influences in social network analysis", Fuzzy Sets Systems, 46(7), Article 108499
* 2024. "A new method to solve matrix game with interval payoffs and its MATLAB Code", International Game Theory Review, 26(3), Article 2450001

For complete list of publications see.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":9" />
